::: {#sol-negate-conditional}

The rule is broken on a day when the tests pass and the build is not deployed:
$P \land \neg Q$.
On a day when the tests fail, the rule is not broken,
whether or not the build is deployed.

"If the tests pass, then the build is not deployed", $P \Rightarrow \neg Q$,
is not the negation:
on a day when the tests fail,
it is true, and so is the rule.

:::
